title: Mosaic Pavements at 'Ein el Fawwar
author: R. W. H[amilton]
location_note: 'Ein el Fawwar in Wadi Fara, between the mouth of Wadi Suweinit and 'Ein Qilt; no map reference; placed by name. Built remains at the spring (not a cave report), so read under plan section 7.
notes: Found in June 1931 during Jerusalem Municipality works to take water from the spring: small chapel and rooms with mosaic floors, a plastered room partly cut in rock (part of the building; not coded). Ribbed sherds, glass lamp fragments and an Arabic coin in the inner court. No date given for the water installations.

features.subtype: spring rising in a rough masonry well inside a once-roofed rectangular enclosure (excavator: 'pool')
